findings.reason: with the wrong actor named, the deliverable "not resumed by any path other than a coordinator's crew resume" would forbid the tree's designed repair resume, so a node would build a gate that blocks the repair loop instead of the supersession window it is aimed at.
findings.text: §17's Why says the 05:07Z resume carried "no coordinator advice" and that "Nobody can say from the record which path issued the resume", but the cited run directory holds `resume-1-advice.txt`, whose text begins "Repair round: r-20261113T012546102955…@ecba127a2883…" and quotes the review's reuse finding; that text is composed only by the repair dispatch (`_repair_resume_advice`, reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:873), which resumes the reviewed run itself (`resumption._resume(run_id, fresh, config=None, advice=advice)`, :117; see also the comment at :1355 that the round's findings "ride a resume of the reviewed run itself") — so the record does name the path, and the mechanism the section must gate is the repair-round resume, not an unnamed automatic resume

findings.reason: a gate whose first clause contradicts its own premise cannot be shown to have passed, and a control aimed at a path the record does not name may go green without exercising the resume that caused the defect.
findings.text: the first clause requires the node to "state in its manifest which path issued the 05:07Z resume" while the Why asserts the record cannot say it, so the clause has no stated evidence by which it can pass or fail; the negative control then names "the automatic path", a path the recorded advice does not identify, leaving the control unanchored to the event the section is about

findings.reason: one verdict cannot close three mechanisms that can land separately, and the done-when's three arms prove none — recording provenance in particular can ship while the gate is absent, and the single verdict would read as covering both.
findings.text: §17 bundles three independently closable deliverables: gating resumes while a review is queued or running, recording the issuing path on every attempt, and re-queueing a review of the new head after a superseding resume
